tiers.name: Visible from two runs
tiers.note: What a careful author already catches by hand. Running the reference and an empty submission reveals these and nothing else, which is exactly where the baseline tops out.

classes.what: The shipped reference solution does not earn full reward.
classes.proof: Run the reference through the verifier and read the reward.

classes.what: A submission that does nothing earns reward, so the verifier is not testing the work.
classes.proof: Run a candidate that exits immediately and read the reward.

classes.what: The reference does not finish inside the budget it declares, which a slower review machine will punish.
classes.proof: Time the reference and compare against the declared budget.

tiers.name: Reached by a designed experiment
tiers.note: Each has a fixed shape, so each can be probed mechanically. This is where the measured gain over the baseline comes from.

classes.what: Material the solver can read contains values only the graded expectations should hold.
classes.proof: Compare graded expectations against every solver visible file and report the overlap with both paths named.

classes.what: The graded cases are narrow enough to satisfy without solving the problem.
classes.proof: Edit the reference so it answers differently on a real input, then show the verifier still awarding full reward.

classes.what: The same submission scores differently on two identical runs.
classes.proof: Run the same submission twice and compare, and read the graded path for entropy that cannot be seeded.

classes.what: A failing candidate causes no zero to be recorded, so failure and a broken harness look alike.
classes.proof: Run a candidate that raises on start up and check a reward was recorded and the process exited cleanly.

classes.what: A graded output path can be redirected outside the directory the harness controls.
classes.proof: Write the answer elsewhere, leave a link behind, and show the verifier still awarding reward.

tiers.name: Needs a reading, not an experiment
tiers.note: The honest boundary of deterministic probing. These need judgement about content, which is the work the agent layer is being built for.

classes.what: The verifier accepts a submission that does not satisfy the stated task, often by grading a candidate against itself.
classes.proof: Build the submission the description forbids and show it scoring full reward.

classes.what: The decisive rule cannot be worked out from anything the solver can see, so a careful answer is marked wrong.
classes.proof: Judgement. Read the visible material as a solver would and ask whether a second reasonable reading exists.

classes.what: The graded cases use an encoding the shipped material never shows.
classes.proof: Enumerate the encodings the graded cases can produce against those the shipped material exhibits.
